title: The Jian Beginner's Primer
summary: Teaches the first cuts and thrusts of the slender double-edged sword to an unawakened student using body strength alone.

title: Handbook of Wrist and Point
summary: Drills the wrist snap and point control of the jian for students whose skin has begun to toughen.

title: Standing Drills of the Slender Sword
summary: Builds leg strength and a steady sword arm through low stances and short cuts for muscle-stage students.

title: Workbook of the Sword Finger
summary: Pairs the free hand's pointing fingers with the blade's line so that aim and distance stay true.

title: Six Lessons on the Double Edge
summary: Explains how to use both edges of the jian and how to meet a cut with the spine side.

title: Treatise on Tassel and Sleeve Practice
summary: Teaches deceptive draws and tassel cues for the jian to students with hardened bones.

title: The Flowing Jian Canon
summary: Shows a newly awakened student how to thread a little qi through the edge and keep the blade moving in one line.

title: Breath and Blade Primer
summary: Links each cut and thrust of the jian to a breath so that qi stays even through a drill.

title: Five Cuts Workbook
summary: Gives five measured cuts at the head and limbs for students who have begun to circulate qi.

title: The Plain Jian Drill-Book
